items.title: File Widerspruch against GdB decision
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats Widerspruch erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Versorgungsamt Beispielfeld, Am Versorgungsamt 1, 49074 Musterosna. Die Frist beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe; ein Bescheid, den wir mit der Post schicken, gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben.
items.computation: Letter dated 27.05.2026 (Wed); absent other evidence, the Aufgabe zur Post (handover to the postal service) is assumed to be the same day, 27.05.2026. The letter states Bekanntgabe fiction occurs on the 4th day after Aufgabe zur Post. Per §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the event (27.05.) is not counted: day 1 = 28.05 (Thu), day 2 = 29.05 (Fri), day 3 = 30.05 (Sat), day 4 = 31.05.2026 (Sun). Since this fictional Bekanntgabe date falls on a Sunday, by established practice (analogous application of §193 BGB to the Bekanntgabefiktion, as applied e.g. under §122 AO/§41 SGB X case law) it shifts to the next business day: Monday, 01.06.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs from this Bekanntgabe date (§187 Abs.1 BGB: day of Bekanntgabe not counted, period starts 02.06.2026) and, per §188 Abs.2 BGB, ends on the day of the following month bearing the same calendar number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 01.07.2026 (Wednesday) — not a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday, so no further shift under §193 BGB applies.

warnings: The letter states the postal-delivery fiction occurs on the 'vierten Tag' (4th day) after mailing, whereas the statutory default under most German administrative-law provisions (§37 Abs.2 VwVfG, §41 Abs.2 SGB X, §122 Abs.2 AO) is the 3rd day; this has been taken at face value as printed.

The exact date the letter was actually handed to the postal service ('Aufgabe zur Post') is not stated separately from the letter date; the computation assumes it equals the printed document date (27.05.2026) — if mailing was later, the deadline shifts accordingly and should be verified against the envelope postmark if kept.

Whether the weekend-shift rule is applied to the Bekanntgabefiktion itself (as opposed to only to the end of the Widerspruchsfrist) is a matter of practice/case law rather than an explicit rule in this letter; if the authority does not apply this shift, the relevant Bekanntgabe date and hence the Widerspruchsfrist could instead be 31.05.2026, which would move the deadline to 30.06.2026 (Tuesday) — the person should, to be safe, treat 2026-06-30 as the latest safe date to submit the Widerspruch.
